hypothesis: Original TRAIN fitting can improve without held-out generation transfer. Uniform label smoothing may regularize the native predictive distribution and reduce persistent greedy loops, while preserving enough non-EOS/EOS distinctions. Poor output calibration has not been measured as the causal explanation; improvement is unproven.
